parameters.name: CheckId
parameters.description: The ID of the check item.

parameters.name: CheckShowName
parameters.description: The name of the custom check item.

parameters.name: CheckTypes
parameters.description: The source type of the situational awareness check item.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: Specifies the page number to display when performing a paginated query. The starting value is **1**, and the default value is **1**.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for requests and responses. The default value is **zh**. Values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
Specifies the maximum number of data entries to display per page when performing a paginated query. The default number of data entries displayed per page is 20, and if the PageSize parameter is empty, it will default to returning 20 data entries.
> It is recommended that the PageSize value is not left empty.

parameters.name: Statuses
parameters.description: The status of the check item.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-check-items --check-id 100000000001 --check-show-name testCheckItemName --check-types SYSTEM --lang zh --statuses RELEASE --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ListCheckItems --region cn-hangzhou --CheckTypes.1 SYSTEM --Statuses.1 RELEASE --CheckId 100000000001 --PageSize 20 --CurrentPage 1 --CheckShowName testCheckItemName --Lang zh
